Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band adds join-code sessions with Concert Director, remote instrument and ARM controls, and scheduled playback. Includes copyable relay diagnostics, Concert Director, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars. Hosted STARTs require all performers to confirm they are armed; failed or missing confirmations cancel the downbeat for the whole band. Hosted ensembles report measured note-dispatch timing or explain when measurements are unavailable, plus RTT and clock stability; followers can fine-tune a local timing offset for duets.
Changelog: Hosted Band timestamps clock probes at send time and restores first-note timing reports. Each follower can enter an exact timing trim and see the value used on the last START.
